n4409810289.headline: Morning Bid: Stocks catch a break after bruising AI selloff
n4409810289.summary: US stock and bond markets caught a break on Monday after another unnerving AI-related selloff, according to Reuters columnist Mike Dolan.
n4409810289.why: The S&P 500 is the main benchmark for large US companies, and AI-linked technology stocks carry significant weight in it. Swings in AI shares move broader market sentiment.
n4409810289.why_moved: Stocks and bonds rebounded on Monday after another sharp AI-related selloff, according to the report.

n5d0bc739da.headline: Dangote calls for probe of NMDPRA CEO over fuel import...
n5d0bc739da.summary: Aliko Dangote, president of Dangote Industries, has called for an investigation of the chief executive of a Nigerian petroleum regulator over fuel imports.
n5d0bc739da.why: Dangote Industries runs a large refinery in Nigeria, so decisions on fuel imports affect its refining economics. Regulatory disputes in Nigeria's downstream oil sector are watched by energy investors.

n60114f6d81.headline: Agoa uncertainty adds fresh strain to South Africa’s poultry industry
n60114f6d81.summary: Trade uncertainty around the AGOA trade preference programme and cheap US chicken imports are deepening pressure on local South African poultry producers.
n60114f6d81.why: The African Growth and Opportunity Act gives eligible African countries preferential access to US markets. Changes to it affect trade flows for exporters and competition for domestic producers.

ncce7a88ab6.headline: Major Bank of England cut could hit those with mortgage
ncce7a88ab6.summary: The Bank of England is widely expected to cut its interest rate from 4% to 3.75% on Thursday. Mortgage holders could feel the effect of the cut.
ncce7a88ab6.why: The Bank of England sets the UK's benchmark interest rate, which feeds into mortgage, savings and borrowing costs and influences sterling and gilt yields.
ncce7a88ab6.why_moved: A widely expected rate cut is priced in, but the decision and guidance still move gilt yields and sterling.

n0686f5c801.headline: Ukraine's Zelenskyy drops NATO goal
n0686f5c801.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy offered to drop Ukraine's aspirations to join NATO during five hours of talks with US envoys in Berlin.
n0686f5c801.why: Ukraine's security arrangements and NATO membership prospects shape geopolitical risk premiums and reconstruction and defence investment outlooks.

n3dfacc48fb.headline: Bond yields tumble as rate cuts, mild inflation and huge foreign inflows buoy sentiment
n3dfacc48fb.summary: South African bond yields tumbled as rate cuts, mild inflation and large foreign inflows lifted sentiment. Market-friendly medium-term budget policy statement and removal from the FATF greylist added to the positive mood.
n3dfacc48fb.why: Government bond yields reflect investor expectations for inflation, interest rates and fiscal risk, and they affect borrowing costs across the economy.
n3dfacc48fb.why_moved: Rate cuts, mild inflation and large foreign inflows boosted sentiment. The medium-term budget statement was viewed as market-friendly and the FATF greylist removal added to the positive mood.

nd88bb3993d.headline: European developer sells off US and Mexican wind and solar assets in billion-dollar deal
nd88bb3993d.summary: Acciona Energia sold wind and solar assets in the United States and Mexico in a billion-dollar deal. It will also build two large new wind farms in South Africa.
nd88bb3993d.why: Acciona Energia is the renewable energy arm of Spain's Acciona group, and portfolio sales and new projects shape its capital allocation and growth.

nc8276ef0c7.headline: Retail property growth gathers pace, driven by Western Cape
nc8276ef0c7.summary: Shopping centres report annualised trading density growth of 5.5%, well ahead of CPI. Western Cape has driven the gains in retail property.
nc8276ef0c7.why: Trading density in shopping centres is a key measure of retail sales strength, and it shapes the income outlook for South African property landlords.

ne7a23c06ae.headline: Analysis-Wild currency swings put emerging markets in the spotlight
ne7a23c06ae.summary: The Hungarian forint, long a niche emerging-market currency, has more than doubled since Trump took office in January. Trader interest has grown since the 'Liberation Day' tariff announcement.
ne7a23c06ae.why: Emerging-market currencies can move sharply on global trade policy and capital flows, affecting hedging costs and returns for international investors.

impacts.name: Hungarian forint
impacts.why: The article describes large swings and strong trader interest in the forint.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

ne109c84b69.headline: Shares stabilise ahead of big central bank decisions
ne109c84b69.summary: The MSCI broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan has fallen as investors await a string of economic data and central bank decisions. Shares are stabilising in the meantime.
ne109c84b69.why: The MSCI Asia Pacific ex-Japan index tracks regional equities and is watched for signals on global risk appetite.

nd889583a10.headline: Ukraine peace talks stretch into second day at start of pivotal week for Europe
nd889583a10.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy resumed talks with US envoys in Berlin on Monday. The US side said a "lot of progress" had been made toward ending the conflict.
nd889583a10.why: The war in Ukraine affects European energy, defence and grain markets, and progress toward a settlement shapes sanctions, reconstruction spending and risk sentiment in Europe.

na3614327b1.headline: India very close to sealing interim trade deal with US: Top official
na3614327b1.summary: Indian Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal said India is very close to concluding an interim trade deal with the US to reduce tariffs, without fixing a timeline.
na3614327b1.why: Tariff arrangements between the US and India affect trade flows, export sectors and the rupee, making them a closely watched macro and trade issue.

nd7edc94dc2.headline: Chariot shares jump on South Africa wind projects milestone
nd7edc94dc2.summary: Chariot Ltd said it completed a financing and strategic equity partnership to fund its investment in two wind generation projects in South Africa, which also reached a milestone.
nd7edc94dc2.why: Chariot develops renewable energy projects, and financing for wind generation affects its growth prospects and South Africa's power supply.

ne5cbf07132.headline: ‘Dangerous deal’: Northern elders reject FIRS–France tax MoU
ne5cbf07132.summary: Northern Elders have asked President Tinubu to terminate a memorandum of understanding between Nigeria's Federal Inland Revenue Service and France on tax data, warning it could expose sensitive economic information.
ne5cbf07132.why: The Federal Inland Revenue Service collects Nigeria's federal taxes, and cross-border tax data sharing affects investor confidence and data security.

n99642ece3a.headline: Battery storage costs fall from Rs 10.18 to Rs 2.1 per unit in 2 years: Govt
n99642ece3a.summary: Battery Energy Storage Systems costs in India have fallen from Rs 10.18 to Rs 2.1 per unit in two years, the Ministry of Power said. Government support is also cited as a factor.
n99642ece3a.why: Cheaper storage makes renewable power more viable, which affects investment in solar, wind and grid infrastructure.

nbeccb9e141.headline: One of America’s biggest consumer tech brand Roomba maker iRobot files for bankruptcy, sold to its Chinese supplier
nbeccb9e141.summary: iRobot, maker of the Roomba vacuum, filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in a Delaware court after 35 years of operation. The company is being sold to its Chinese supplier.
nbeccb9e141.why: iRobot is a US consumer robotics company, and its collapse shows pressure on hardware makers facing cheaper Asian competition.

nc040d949c1.headline: No 'out-of-pocket expenses' for childbirth in China from 2026
nc040d949c1.summary: China's national healthcare security administration said the country will cover all out-of-pocket expenses related to childbirth next year, as authorities seek to encourage births.
nc040d949c1.why: Government policies to raise birth rates affect household spending, healthcare funding and demographic trends that shape long-term economic growth.

n7070bd7cc5.headline: BHP Group (BHP) Teams Up With BlackRock For $2 Billion Investment
n7070bd7cc5.summary: BlackRock's Global Infrastructure Partners will invest $2 billion in BHP, the mining company announced on December 9th.
n7070bd7cc5.why: BHP is one of the world's largest mining companies, and capital partnerships can fund its infrastructure and operations in copper, iron ore and other commodities.

n922374809d.headline: Federation account inflows hit N23tn in 10 months – RMAFC
n922374809d.summary: Nigeria's Federation Account inflows surged to N23 trillion in 10 months, driven by fiscal reforms and the new Nigeria Tax Act, 2025, according to RMAFC.
n922374809d.why: Federation Account inflows fund federal, state and local governments in Nigeria. Revenue trends shape fiscal capacity and the government's borrowing needs.

n010e375876.headline: India a preferred destination for data centres, no shortage of power: Piyush Goyal
n010e375876.summary: Union Minister Piyush Goyal said India is a preferred destination for data centres, citing no shortage of electricity and a 500GW national grid able to meet rising demand.
n010e375876.why: Data centres are major consumers of electricity, so power availability is a key factor in where AI and cloud infrastructure is built. Government statements signal policy support for the sector.

nc7221f6b62.headline: FAAC revenue drops as FG, states, LGs share N1.928 trillion in November
nc7221f6b62.summary: Federal, state and local governments shared a total of N1.928 trillion from Federation Account revenue for November 2025, with revenue dropping compared with the prior period.
nc7221f6b62.why: Federation Account allocations are Nigeria's main source of revenue for its three tiers of government. Monthly changes indicate fiscal conditions and oil and tax income.

n9ec68c2f3b.headline: Cattle futures slide as beef markets cool after record highs - CME
n9ec68c2f3b.summary: CME cattle futures fell as beef markets cooled after record highs, while hog futures edged higher as pork prices sent mixed signals.
n9ec68c2f3b.why: Live cattle and lean hog futures, traded on the CME in Chicago, are benchmarks for US meat prices and hedging by producers and processors.

nc49861819b.headline: Oracle reportedly signs major huge cloud data center deals
nc49861819b.summary: Oracle reportedly signed major cloud data center deals and disclosed $248 billion in data center commitments. The report was published by TechRadar.
nc49861819b.why: Oracle is a large US enterprise software and cloud infrastructure company, and its data center commitments signal demand for AI and cloud computing capacity.

impacts.name: Oracle
impacts.why: Large data center commitments indicate heavy capital spending on cloud and AI infrastructure.

ne1867fce37.headline: Missouri's minimum wage will increase by more than a dollar in 2026
ne1867fce37.summary: Missouri's minimum wage rises $1.25 an hour for the second year in a row, and a new law signed by Gov. Mike Kehoe ends automatic inflation increases.
ne1867fce37.why: Minimum wage levels affect labour costs for low-wage employers such as retailers and restaurants.

source.name: KCUR - Kansas City news and NPR

sources.name: KCUR - Kansas City news and NPR

n934fe14370.headline: Rupee Slumps 25 Paise To Close At All-Time Low Of 90.74 Against U.S. Dollar
n934fe14370.summary: The Indian rupee fell to a record low of 90.80 intraday before settling at a provisional 90.74 against the US dollar, a loss of 25 paise from the prior session.
n934fe14370.why: The rupee's value against the dollar affects India's import costs, inflation and the returns foreign investors earn on Indian assets.
n934fe14370.why_moved: The rupee weakened to a record low against the dollar in the Monday session, with the input giving no specific cause.

nd284abcd98.headline: Japan business mood hits 4-year high
nd284abcd98.summary: Big Japanese manufacturers' business sentiment hit a four-year high in the three months to December, a survey showed, reinforcing expectations the central bank will raise rates this week.
nd284abcd98.why: The Bank of Japan's policy rate decisions influence Japanese bond yields and the yen, which affect global carry trades and investors with Japan exposure.

n0bac347b89.headline: Todd Combs, Key Investment Manager, Just Left Berkshire Hathaway for JPMorgan Chase. Does the Shakeup Bode Well For the Stock?
n0bac347b89.summary: Investment manager Todd Combs has left Berkshire Hathaway for JPMorgan Chase. Combs was previously CEO of GEICO Insurance and helped manage about 10% of Berkshire's portfolio.
n0bac347b89.why: Berkshire Hathaway is Warren Buffett's conglomerate with large insurance and equity holdings, and changes in its investment team can draw investor attention.

nf9ad11240b.headline: ABB and HDF Energy to develop high-power fuel cell unit for large seagoing ships
nf9ad11240b.summary: ABB and HDF Energy have signed a joint-development agreement to build a high-power fuel cell unit for marine applications. The megawatt-scale hydrogen fuel cells are intended for large seagoing ships.
nf9ad11240b.why: ABB is a Swiss industrial technology group, and marine decarbonisation through hydrogen fuel cells is an emerging business opportunity in shipping.

nc4129ac621.headline: China to fork out cash to boost flagging birth rates
nc4129ac621.summary: China plans full reimbursement of all medical expenses related to childbirth, including prenatal check-ups. The measure aims to boost flagging birth rates.
nc4129ac621.why: China's demographic decline affects its labour supply and long-term growth, so state policy on births is closely watched by investors.

nbc5d3a0e9f.headline: TCS, Infosys, Cognizant to bear brunt of Trump’s $1,00,000 H-1B visa fee
nbc5d3a0e9f.summary: Trump's $100,000 fee for new H-1B workers hired from outside the US is expected to hurt IT outsourcing and staffing firms. TCS, Infosys and Cognizant are cited.
nbc5d3a0e9f.why: H-1B visas are a key channel for Indian IT services firms staffing US clients, so changes to their cost affect these companies' margins.

impacts.name: Cognizant
impacts.why: Cognizant is named among the IT outsourcing and staffing firms expected to bear the fee's impact.

n394dc464ac.headline: Indonesia ships first frozen durian export to China
n394dc464ac.summary: Indonesia's Agricultural Quarantine Agency has released the country's first frozen durian export, totaling 48 tons, bound for China. The shipment is a new agricultural trade flow.
n394dc464ac.why: Durian is a high-value tropical fruit, and frozen exports open a new route for Southeast Asian agricultural producers into the large Chinese food market.

ne995faa5b3.headline: iRobot has filed for bankruptcy
ne995faa5b3.summary: iRobot, known for its Roomba robot vacuums, has filed for bankruptcy. The company has proposed that control be handed over to another party.
ne995faa5b3.why: iRobot is a US consumer robotics maker whose bankruptcy filing signals financial distress and likely changes to ownership of the company and its brand.

ne38e7e77dd.headline: Experts: Ending Affordable Care Act subsidies affects everyone's healthcare
ne38e7e77dd.summary: A debate in Congress over the future of tax subsidies tied to the Affordable Care Act could affect all Americans, according to experts. The outcome remains undecided.
ne38e7e77dd.why: ACA subsidies affect insurance premiums, household healthcare costs and the finances of insurers and health providers. Congressional decisions on them are a recurring policy risk for the US health sector.

ne29e14631b.headline: Rupee slumps 25 paise to close at all-time low of 90.74 against US dollar
ne29e14631b.summary: The rupee fell 25 paise to close at an all-time low of 90.74 against the US dollar. It touched an intra-day low of 90.80 after opening at 90.53.
ne29e14631b.why: The rupee's level against the dollar affects India's import costs, inflation and foreign investment flows. India is a major importer of oil and other dollar-priced commodities.
ne29e14631b.why_moved: The rupee opened at 90.53 per dollar, then weakened through the session to a record intra-day low of 90.80 before closing at 90.74.

n6c97272f96.headline: Stronger ringgit welcomed
n6c97272f96.summary: A stronger ringgit has helped Malaysians buying foreign products, travelling and funding children's studies abroad. The currency's gain is described as a boon for many households.
n6c97272f96.why: The ringgit's exchange rate affects import prices, outbound travel costs and the earnings of exporters. It is the currency of Malaysia.

nc74a2f3a37.headline: Halogen Capital Completes RM13.3 Million Funding Round, Led by Kenanga Investment Bank and 500 Global, to Drive Digital Asset Innovation in Malaysia
nc74a2f3a37.summary: Halogen Capital completed a RM13.3 million funding round led by Kenanga Investment Bank and 500 Global, with participation from global and regional investors, to drive digital asset innovation in Malaysia.
nc74a2f3a37.why: Venture funding for digital asset firms indicates investor appetite for crypto and fintech startups in Southeast Asian markets.

nd9aefe8fe8.headline: IP rider changes meant to address growing shift from private to public healthcare: Ong Ye Kung
nd9aefe8fe8.summary: Health Minister Ong Ye Kung said changes to Integrated Shield Plan riders aim to address people shifting from private to public healthcare as insurance premiums rise.
nd9aefe8fe8.why: Integrated Shield Plans are Singapore's private health insurance riders that cover hospital costs, and premium levels affect household spending and insurers.

n02e669ee59.headline: Stock market update: Here is why Sensex, Nifty lost last week's gains in Monday slide
n02e669ee59.summary: Indian indices fell after losing last week's gains, with an uncertain India-US trade deal, foreign institutional outflows, weak Asian cues and a rupee at a record low cited as drivers.
n02e669ee59.why: The BSE Sensex and NSE Nifty 50 are India's benchmark equity indices, tracking large listed companies on the country's two major exchanges.
n02e669ee59.why_moved: Uncertainty over the India-US trade deal, foreign institutional outflows, weak Asian cues and a record-low rupee weighed on Indian stocks.

n70dc03ea62.headline: MEPA says oil spread in Colombo, mostly contained
n70dc03ea62.summary: A crude oil rupture occurred near the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation unloading buoy at Colombo Port during operations with the vessel MT ASP Avana. The Marine Environmental authority said the spill was mostly contained.
n70dc03ea62.why: Ceylon Petroleum Corporation is Sri Lanka's state fuel importer, so disruptions at its unloading facilities can affect domestic fuel supply.

nbf7818d322.headline: SoftBank CEO Masayoshi Son Just Delivered Incredible News to Nvidia Investors
nbf7818d322.summary: SoftBank CEO Masayoshi Son addressed why the holding company unloaded its $5.8 billion stake in Nvidia. The comments were reported by Yahoo Finance.
nbf7818d322.why: SoftBank Group is a Japanese technology investment holding company with large stakes in AI and chip firms. Its investment decisions in Nvidia are closely watched by investors.

nfaaf53d804.headline: iRobot's bankruptcy could change your Roomba forever - here's how and why
nfaaf53d804.summary: iRobot, which pioneered the U.S. robot vacuum market, is no longer setting the pace in the category following its bankruptcy. ZDNET outlines what may come next for the Roomba.
nfaaf53d804.why: iRobot is a U.S. consumer robotics maker known for the Roomba robot vacuum. Its bankruptcy affects competition and pricing in the connected home appliance market.
